title: Changes made to Workers may be delayed or disrupted

timeline.body: Cloudflare is aware of and investigating issues related to creating, editing and deleting Workers. Impact is limited to changing Workers — Workers that are already deployed are unaffected.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: We are continuing to work on a fix for the issue.
timeline.label: identified

timeline.body: We are continuing to monitor for any further issues.
timeline.label: monitoring
